intent: A tagged-value type mirroring SQLite's dynamic column typing (NONE/INTEGER/REAL/TEXT/BLOB), implicitly convertible to/from string for drop-in use wherever legacy code expects a string-typed value.

objects.name: SQValue
objects.role: TYPE enum + typed storage; constructors from int64_t/double/const char*/string; operator string(); friend operator+/==/!=; empty()/size(); operator<<

name_fit.note: Q naming matches other SQLite-adjacent types (SQResult, SQuery)

naming_quality.note: consistent; integer/real/text all coexist rather than a union, a deliberate simplicity tradeoff
